# GetMoved

> GetMoved (getmoved.app) is a moving-services marketplace for the United States.
> Customers describe their move (or upload a short walkthrough video that our AI turns
> into an inventory) and receive real, competing quotes from licensed and insured
> moving companies — no phone calls required. Movers join the platform to receive
> qualified leads and manage quotes, work orders and invoicing.

Key facts:
- Service: free moving quotes from vetted, licensed movers; AI video inventory (record
  a walkthrough, our computer-vision model builds the item list automatically)
- Coverage: United States, currently live in New York and New Jersey; city pages for 48
  further metros (including Phoenix and Tucson, Arizona) are open for waitlist signups
- Cost to customers: free, no obligation
- For moving companies: lead generation, quote management, dispatch, invoicing (SaaS)

## Main pages
- [Home / get a quote](https://getmoved.app/): start a free moving quote
- [How it works](https://getmoved.app/how-it-works.html): the 3-step process
- [Free moving quote](https://getmoved.app/free-moving-quote.html): quote form
- [For movers](https://getmoved.app/for-movers.html): join as a moving company
- [Register as mover](https://getmoved.app/register-as-mover.html)
- [New York movers](https://getmoved.app/new-york-movers.html)
- [New Jersey movers](https://getmoved.app/new-jersey-movers.html)
- [Mobile app](https://getmoved.app/mobile-app.html)
- [Contact](https://getmoved.app/contact.html)
- [Pricing](https://getmoved.app/pricing.html)
- [Software for movers](https://getmoved.app/software.html)

## City pages
Each metro has its own page with local moving conditions, timing and FAQ, at
https://getmoved.app/<city>-movers.html — for example:
- [Phoenix movers](https://getmoved.app/phoenix-movers.html)
- [Tucson movers](https://getmoved.app/tucson-movers.html)
- [Los Angeles movers](https://getmoved.app/los-angeles-movers.html)
- [Houston movers](https://getmoved.app/houston-movers.html)
The full list of indexable pages is in https://getmoved.app/sitemap.xml

## Portal
- [Customer & mover portal](https://portal.getmoved.app/): sign in to manage quotes,
  requests and invoices. Requires an account.
